body:
I recently ordered some etizolam liquid from an online vendor, within the United States, who makes their own chemicals. I was not expecting much, as my previous experiences with benzos, namely diazepam and alprazolam, really just made me incredibly tired. My experience with Etizolam went slightly different though.
4:00pm - Filled 1/4th teaspoon (1.25ml) with the liquid etizolam, and since it was 1mg per ml, I was taking 1.25mg. I began by dipping my tongue into the liquid and waiting 15 minutes to make sure it was anything I could not handle since it was my first time with this vendor.
4:15pm - I began to feel muscle relaxation, so I went ahead and took the rest of the liquid. I'm glad that this kicked in so quickly.
4:30pm - I was completely relaxed with a mild euphoria, not unlike alprazolam.
4:45pm - The relaxation turned to minor sleepiness as time progressed and it started to annoy me because I did not want to sleep. So instead, I decided to get up and do random activities such as making dinner or cleaning. Once I was up and going, it was not difficult to stay awake at all, although my limbs were pretty heavy.
5:30pm - I made dinner, but I was not all that hungry. Slight appetite suppression.
6:00pm - The effects are still going strong.  My mild anxiety was completely gone, and I could definitely see where this could be used both recreationally and therapeutically with great results. I began to get an urge to go out and do something, so I decided to go for a longboard ride through my university's campus, and it was fantastic.  Nothing overly special, but I just felt so fluid on my board. I had absolutely no problem with shortness of breath or pushing constantly. Everything was going great.
7:00pm - By about 3 hours into it, the anxiolytic effects were still going strong, and the muscle relaxation was nice, but the euphoria had declined.
Overall, the muscle relaxation went long into the night and I slept well. I have also mixed this with about 4g of kratom since, and it mixes pleasantly. I would say that etizolam is on par with the relaxation of alprazolam, but has a sedation that can be fought off if necessary. I still prefer to use this drug as a tool to aid in the comedown of other drugs or to be mixed, but it is still great on its own as well.
